chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, he said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام used to say: “Forbid your women from nursing right and left, for they forget.”

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator through whom this report is transmitted
key_terms.شِمَالًا: to the left; here meaning in another direction
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
key_terms.يَمِينًا: to the right; here meaning in one direction

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about women breastfeeding indiscriminately?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a saying of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام advising that women should be restrained from breastfeeding indiscriminately. It reflects guidance related to family conduct and caution in matters of nursing.
